items.title: [ClinicalTrials] A Trial of Pirtobrutinib (LOXO-305) Plus Venetoclax and Rituximab (PVR) Versus Venetoclax and Rituximab (VR) in Previously Treated Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia/Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (CLL/SLL) (Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING)
items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT04965493 | Sponsor: Loxo Oncology, Inc. | Condition: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia, Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING. The purpose of this study is to compare the efficacy and safety of fixed duration pirtobruitinib (LOXO-305) with VR (Arm A) compared to VR alone (Arm B) in patients with CLL/SLL who have been previously treated with at least one prior line of therapy. Participation could last up to five years.

items.snippet: NCT ID: NCT06001606 | Sponsor: Seoul National University Hospital | Condition: Zoster, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, Vaccine Reaction | Phase: Phase 3 | Status: COMPLETED. To investigate the immunogenicity, reactogenicity and safety of 2 doses of the adjuvanted herpes zoster subunit vaccine (Shingrix) in patients with SLE in a randomized trial.
